svg.title: Tray assignment
svg.desc: Which trays move, where to, and in which order.
svg.metadata: ["Tray T17 must reach bay B21, but it is enclosed: tray T15 occupies stall P15, tray T20 occupies stall P20, and charger C16 is a dead end. Bay B21 still holds the empty tray T21.", "Tray assignment chooses a route for tray T17 (via stall P15) and finds what stands on it: tray T15, and tray T21 in the bay.", "It picks a free stall for each: tray T15 to stall P19, tray T21 to stall P23, and orders both moves before tray T17's move."]
